items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that every section of the plus construction becomes, after restricting to a covering, the image of a section of the original presheaf under the canonical map (statement lines 2163-2170). The proof is a short but complete argument: the given section is presented by a compatible family over a covering, and after refining the covering the author computes the pullback of the section with the refined covering and identifies it with the image of a member of the family (proof lines 2173-2180). The non-formal content is the identification of the restriction with the image of a member. The claim is H1: a one-step argument with its input named.
